info.title: Madarek Platform API
info.description:
مدارك — Arabic-first smart-learning platform. Non-browser (Expo) clients should start at `docs/api/mobile-auth.md`.

Conventions: every endpoint lives under `/api/v1` and answers `{ data: … }`
(errors: `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`, Arabic messages, UPPER_SNAKE codes).
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (15 min) + a 7-day `mdrk_refresh` cookie
for rotation. The contract is ADDITIVE-ONLY for mobile clients — enforced by
`backend/tests/contract/api-contract.test.ts` against the committed snapshot.

Generated from the live Express route table + the real zod DTOs; response field
shapes on snapshot-covered operations come from the committed contract snapshot
(top-level observed fields, additionalProperties open).

bearerAuth.description: Access token minted by POST /api/v1/auth/login (HS256; claims sub/role/inst/type; 15 min TTL). On 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED → POST /api/v1/auth/refresh.

refreshCookie.name: mdrk_refresh
refreshCookie.description: httpOnly refresh cookie (SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/v1/auth, 7 days) consumed by POST /api/v1/auth/refresh. Native clients must persist this cookie (cookie jar) — the refresh endpoint does not (yet) accept a body token.

data.description: Payload — shape per endpoint (see per-operation 2xx schemas).

code.description: UPPER_SNAKE machine code. Known values: BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHENTICATED, TOKEN_EXPIRED, INVALID_CREDENTIALS, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, INSTITUTION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED, INSTITUTION_CONTEXT_INVALID, REG_NUMBER_AMBIGUOUS

message.description: Human message (Arabic — D17-3); render verbatim in toasts.

details.description: Optional structured details (e.g. zod flatten() for VALIDATION_ERROR).

warnings: GET /api/v1/live/sessions: duplicate registration for GET /api/v1/live/sessions — kept the first
POST /api/v1/live/sessions: duplicate registration for POST /api/v1/live/sessions — kept the first
POST /api/v1/live/sessions/:id/lifecycle: duplicate registration for POST /api/v1/live/sessions/{id}/lifecycle — kept the first
x-generator.securityHeuristic: bearerAuth is attached when the route (or its router-level gate) uses authMiddleware; optionalAuthMiddleware and ungated routes are marked security:[]. Per-endpoint role/capability gates (requireRole/requireCapability) are NOT modelled — see the route sources.
